runtime.bootstrap: TimerBootstrapper installs TimerManager.UpdateTimers after assemblies load; it removes existing package callbacks first to avoid duplicate insertion.

lifecycleSemantics.start: Resets CurrentTime to the initial value. Registers only when transitioning from not running to running. Repeated Start while running resets the timer without duplicate registration or a second OnTimerStart callback.
lifecycleSemantics.stop: Stops and deregisters. Invokes OnTimerStop only when transitioning from running to stopped.
lifecycleSemantics.pause: Deregisters while preserving CurrentTime. Does not invoke OnTimerStop.
lifecycleSemantics.resume: Registers again while preserving CurrentTime. Does not invoke OnTimerStart.
lifecycleSemantics.reset: Changes CurrentTime but does not alter running/paused state.
lifecycleSemantics.dispose: Permanently deregisters; if running, invokes OnTimerStop. Start, Resume, and Reset after disposal throw ObjectDisposedException.
lifecycleSemantics.events: OnTimerStart and OnTimerStop are public Action fields initialized to no-op delegates; invoking is null-safe if assigned null.

types.name: Timer

properties.name: CurrentTime
properties.summary: Current value in seconds; interpretation depends on derived timer.

fields.name: OnTimerStart
fields.summary: Invoked on Start transition to running.

fields.name: OnTimerStop
fields.summary: Invoked on Stop transition and when disposing an active timer.

methods.name: Start
methods.behavior: Resets to initial value and starts or restarts timer.

methods.name: Stop
methods.behavior: Stops and deregisters; idempotent.

methods.name: Pause
methods.behavior: Deregisters without resetting time or firing OnTimerStop.

methods.name: Resume
methods.behavior: Re-registers without resetting time or firing OnTimerStart.

methods.name: Tick
methods.behavior: Advances using the supplied finite, non-negative delta.

methods.name: IsFinished
methods.behavior: Completion state defined by each concrete timer.

methods.name: Reset
methods.behavior: Restores initial value while preserving running state.

methods.name: Reset
methods.behavior: Sets a new finite, non-negative initial value and resets.
methods.throws: ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative or non-finite value; ObjectDisposedException after Dispose.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.behavior: Permanently deregisters and stops the timer; idempotent.

constraints: Constructor time and Reset(float) time must be finite and non-negative.
Tick(deltaTime) implementations reject negative, NaN, and infinite deltas.

properties.name: Progress
properties.summary: Elapsed fraction clamped to [0,1]. A zero-duration timer returns 1 to avoid division by zero.

methods.name: Tick
methods.behavior: Subtracts delta and clamps at zero; calls Stop at completion.

types.name: IntervalTimer

methods.name: Tick
methods.behavior: Counts down and invokes OnInterval for every interval threshold crossed, including multiple thresholds in one frame.

methods.name: Reset
methods.behavior: Restores countdown and first interval threshold.

methods.name: Reset
methods.behavior: Changes total duration and restores interval threshold.

constraints: intervalSeconds must be finite and greater than zero.
An interval longer than totalTime produces no interval callbacks.

types.name: FrequencyTimer

fields.name: OnTick
fields.summary: Invoked once per elapsed frequency interval.

methods.name: Tick
methods.behavior: Accumulates time and invokes OnTick for every elapsed threshold, preserving the remainder.

methods.name: Reset
methods.behavior: Clears elapsed-time accumulator.

methods.name: Reset
methods.behavior: Changes rate and clears accumulator.

constraints: ticksPerSecond must be greater than zero.
IsFinished is true whenever the timer is not running.

methods.name: Tick
methods.behavior: Adds deltaTime while running.

methods.name: RegisterTimer
methods.behavior: Adds non-null timer once; duplicate registrations are ignored.

methods.name: DeregisterTimer
methods.behavior: Removes timer if present.

methods.name: UpdateTimers
methods.behavior: Called by PlayerLoop in Update; advances a snapshot using Time.deltaTime. Reentrant calls are ignored.

methods.name: Clear
methods.behavior: Disposes currently registered timers and clears the registry.

methods.name: RemoveSystem
methods.signature: static void RemoveSystem<T>(ref PlayerLoopSystem loop, in PlayerLoopSystem systemToRemove)
methods.behavior: Removes all nested systems matching both type and updateDelegate.

methods.name: InsertSystem
methods.signature: static bool InsertSystem<T>(ref PlayerLoopSystem loop, in PlayerLoopSystem systemToInsert, int index)
methods.behavior: Inserts into first parent whose type is T; false when parent is absent; throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for invalid child index.

methods.name: PrintPlayerLoop
methods.behavior: Writes the full nested PlayerLoop tree to the Unity Console; handles nodes without children.

failureModes: CountdownTimer and base Timer durations must be finite and non-negative.
IntervalTimer interval must be finite and greater than zero.
FrequencyTimer ticksPerSecond must be greater than zero.
Timer.Start, Resume, and Reset after Dispose throw ObjectDisposedException.

minimalExamples.countdown: var timer = new CountdownTimer(5f); timer.OnTimerStop += OnFinished; timer.Start();
minimalExamples.pauseResume:
timer.Pause(); // preserves remaining time
timer.Resume(); // continues from remaining time
minimalExamples.interval: var timer = new IntervalTimer(10f, 2f); timer.OnInterval += OnInterval; timer.Start();
minimalExamples.frequency: var timer = new FrequencyTimer(4); timer.OnTick += OnTick; timer.Start();
minimalExamples.stopwatch: var timer = new StopwatchTimer(); timer.Start(); float elapsed = timer.CurrentTime;

compatibilityNotes: Public namespace is LOGIYGames.Timers and assembly is LOGIYGames.Timers.
Runtime asmdef retains existing GUID reference to the project's Extensions assembly.
